scene: You glide through the archway into a grand transit terminal.
picture: A flat side-view pixel transit terminal along a polished metal floor. Left, the girl with a black braid in a teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair beside the glowing neon archway. Up high, an airship floats beside a gangway. Centre, a glass elevator stands open. Far right waits a striped steam train.
shown: a tethered brass airship waiting with an open ramp, floating up high
a transparent cylindrical elevator with open doors, standing at the centre
a brightly striped steam train puffing sweet vapour, waiting at the far right

variants.scene: You enter the bustling terminal, your magic wrench humming with excitement.
Under the massive arched ceiling, you wonder if {quest} waits above or below.
Train whistles and humming gears echo across the grand station platforms.
